# Jigsawstack

JigsawStack provides a suite of custom small AI models integrated into scalable infrastructure, enabling developers to build AI-powered applications efficiently.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/jigsawstack/.

## Actions

- **Generate Image from Prompt** (read-only): Generate images from text prompts.
- **Sentiment Analysis** (read-only): Analyze text sentiment.
- **Text to Speech** (read-only): Convert text to natural-sounding speech.
- **Web Search** (read-only): Perform AI-powered web search with AI overview and geo-aware results.
